info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Fitness Memberships Classes-v3-spec
info.description: The Fitness Membership Classes API provides access to a comprehensive list of fitness membership classes offered by the facility. This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed information about various classes, including schedules, types, and available spots. It's primarily intended for gym members looking to explore class options or for potential members considering enrollment. With this API, developers can integrate class listings into applications or websites, enhancing the user experience for fitness enthusiasts.

get.description: Fetch a list of classes that are part of the membership offerings, including their details and availability. This endpoint provides insight into all the classes that members can attend as part of their membership.
